events.name: bp_early_redir
events.desc: Early redirects sent to branch predictor. This happens when either the decoder or dispatch logic is able to detect that the branch predictor needs to be redirected.

events.name: bp_fe_redir.all
events.desc: Redirects of the pipeline frontend caused by any reason.

events.name: bp_fe_redir.ex_redir
events.desc: Redirects of the pipeline frontend caused by mispredicts. These are used for branch direction correction and handling indirect branch target mispredicts.

events.name: bp_fe_redir.resync
events.desc: Redirects of the pipeline frontend caused by resyncs. These are retire time pipeline restarts.

events.name: bp_l1_tlb_fetch_hit.all
events.desc: Instruction fetches that hit in the L1 ITLB for all page sizes.

events.name: bp_l1_tlb_fetch_hit.if1g
events.desc: Instruction fetches that hit in the L1 ITLB for 1G pages.

events.name: bp_l1_tlb_fetch_hit.if2m
events.desc: Instruction fetches that hit in the L1 ITLB for 2M pages.

events.name: bp_l1_tlb_fetch_hit.if4k
events.desc: Instruction fetches that hit in the L1 ITLB for 4k or coalesced pages (16k pages created from four adjacent 4k pages).

events.name: bp_l1_tlb_miss_l2_tlb_hit
events.desc: Instruction fetches that miss in the L1 ITLB but hit in the L2 ITLB.

events.name: bp_l1_tlb_miss_l2_tlb_miss.all
events.desc: Instruction fetches that miss in both the L1 and L2 ITLBs (page-table walks requested) for all page sizes.

events.name: bp_l1_tlb_miss_l2_tlb_miss.coalesced_4k
events.desc: Instruction fetches that miss in both the L1 and L2 ITLBs (page-table walks requested) for coalesced pages (16k pages created from four adjacent 4k pages).

events.name: bp_l1_tlb_miss_l2_tlb_miss.if1g
events.desc: Instruction fetches that miss in both the L1 and L2 ITLBs (page-table walks requested) for 1G pages.

events.name: bp_l1_tlb_miss_l2_tlb_miss.if2m
events.desc: Instruction fetches that miss in both the L1 and L2 ITLBs (page-table walks requested) for 2M pages.

events.name: bp_l1_tlb_miss_l2_tlb_miss.if4k
events.desc: Instruction fetches that miss in both the L1 and L2 ITLBs (page-table walks requested) for 4k pages.

events.name: bp_pipe_correct
events.desc: Branch predictor pipeline flushes due to internal conditions such as a second level prediction structure.

events.name: bp_var_target_pred
events.desc: Indirect predictions (branch used the indirect predictor to make a prediction).

events.name: de_additional_resource_stalls.dispatch_stalls

events.name: de_dis_ops_from_decoder.any_int

events.name: de_dispatch_stall_cycle_dynamic_tokens_part1.fp_sch_rsrc_stall

events.desc: Cycles where a dispatch group is valid but does not get dispatched due to taken branch buffer resource stalls.

events.name: de_dispatch_stall_cycle_dynamic_tokens_part2.all
events.desc: Cycles where a dispatch group is valid but does not get dispatched due to any token stalls.

events.name: de_dispatch_stall_cycle_dynamic_tokens_part2.int_sq0

events.name: de_no_dispatch_per_slot.backend_stalls
events.desc: Dispatch slots in each cycle that were unused because of backend stalls.

events.name: de_no_dispatch_per_slot.no_ops_from_frontend
events.desc: Dispatch slots in each cycle that were empty because the frontend did not supply ops.

events.name: de_no_dispatch_per_slot.no_ops_from_frontend_cmask8
events.desc: Cycles in which this event counts at least 8: Dispatch slots in each cycle that were empty because the frontend did not supply ops.

events.name: de_no_dispatch_per_slot.smt_contention
events.desc: Dispatch slots in each cycle that were unused because the dispatch cycle was granted to the other SMT thread.

events.name: de_op_queue_empty
events.desc: Cycles where the op queue is empty. Such cycles indicate that the frontend is not delivering instructions fast enough.

events.name: de_src_op_disp.all
events.desc: Ops dispatched from any source.

events.name: de_src_op_disp.op_cache
events.desc: Ops dispatched from op cache.

events.name: de_src_op_disp.x86_decoder
events.desc: Ops dispatched from x86 decoder.

events.name: ex_div_busy
events.desc: Cycles where the divider is busy.

events.name: ex_div_count
events.desc: Divide ops executed.

events.name: ex_mprof_ibs_ops.filtered
events.desc: Memory Profiler IBS tagged ops that retired but were discarded due to IBS filtering.

events.name: ex_mprof_ibs_ops.rollovers
events.desc: Memory Profiler IBS periodic counter rollovers due to a previous tagged op not being IBS complete.

events.name: ex_mprof_ibs_ops.tagged
events.desc: Memory Profiler IBS tagged ops.

events.name: ex_mprof_ibs_ops.tagged_ret
events.desc: Memory Profiler IBS tagged ops that retired.

events.name: ex_mprof_ibs_ops.valid
events.desc: Memory Profiler IBS tagged ops that resulted in a valid sample and an IBS interrupt.

events.name: ex_no_retire.empty
events.desc: Cycles where the thread does not retire any ops due to a lack of valid ops in the retire queue (may be caused by front-end bottlenecks or pipeline redirects).

events.name: ex_no_retire.load_not_complete
events.desc: Cycles where the thread does not retire any ops due to missing load completion.

events.name: ex_no_retire.not_complete
events.desc: Cycles where the thread does not retire any ops as the oldest retire slot is waiting to be marked as completed.

events.name: ex_no_retire.other
events.desc: Cycles where the thread does not retire any ops due to other reasons (retire breaks, traps, faults, etc.).

events.name: ex_no_retire.thread_not_selected
events.desc: Cycles where the thread does not retire any ops as thread arbitration did not select the current thread.

events.name: ex_ret_brn
events.desc: Retired branch instructions (all types of architectural control flow changes, including exceptions and interrupts).

events.name: ex_ret_brn_cond
events.desc: Retired conditional branch instructions.

events.name: ex_ret_brn_cond_misp
events.desc: Retired conditional branch instructions that were mispredicted due to direction mismatch.

events.name: ex_ret_brn_far
events.desc: Retired far control transfers (far call, far jump, far return, IRET, SYSCALL and SYSRET, plus exceptions and interrupts). Far control transfers are not subject to branch prediction.

events.name: ex_ret_brn_ind
events.desc: Retired indirect branch instructions.

events.name: ex_ret_brn_ind_misp
events.desc: Retired indirect branch instructions that were mispredicted (only EX mispredicts). Each misprediction incurs the same penalty as that of a mispredicted conditional branch instruction.

events.name: ex_ret_brn_misp
events.desc: Retired branch instructions that were mispredicted.

events.name: ex_ret_brn_tkn
events.desc: Retired taken branch instructions (all types of architectural control flow changes, including exceptions and interrupts).

events.name: ex_ret_brn_tkn_misp
events.desc: Retired taken branch instructions that were mispredicted.

events.name: ex_ret_brn_uncond
events.desc: Retired unconditional branch instructions.

events.name: ex_ret_brn_uncond_ind_near_misp
events.desc: Retired unconditional indirect near branch instructions that were mispredicted.

events.name: ex_ret_fused_instr
events.desc: Retired fused instructions.

events.name: ex_ret_instr
events.desc: Retired instructions.

events.name: ex_ret_near_ret
events.desc: Retired near returns (RET or RET Iw).

events.name: ex_ret_near_ret_mispred
events.desc: Retired near returns that were mispredicted. Each misprediction incurs the same penalty as that of a mispredicted conditional branch instruction.

events.name: ex_ret_ops
events.desc: Retired macro-ops.

events.name: ex_ret_ucode_instr
events.desc: Retired microcoded instructions.

events.name: ex_ret_ucode_ops
